summary.intent: Take the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge (Soony supply-chain launch) from data analysis through to a hosted, demo-ready product ('Lighthouse') that watches portal drops, finds contradictions, and drafts/acts on supplier emails and approvals, ahead of a 12:45 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses launch (art book overbooking, failed statues, etc.), built and shipped the Lighthouse agent app with buyer/approver roles, routines and demo state, and moved lighthouse.stenglein.dev hosting to ada. Real mail sending was just switched on for the ada demo (committed locally, not pushed); several local commits remain unpushed.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip); no webhooks, so change detection must poll and compare SHA-256, since files are replaced under the same name.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/; .env holds the token and .env.example is committed.
Demo state is managed via scripts/demo.sh (story, save-story) with ASK_DEMO_OPEN=on and ASK_DEMO_HOST; ASK_MAIL_DRY=on records emails only, ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=dry_run disables calls.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist in the repo; tasks are claimed in PROGRESS.md.
Entire hooks only create a checkpoint when repo files changed; a session with no file changes logs 'skipping checkpoint'.
Hosting on ada lives in ~/Jonas/StartMunichHack/lighthouse-host with tmux sessions ask-soony-demo and lighthouse-tunnel; it is a code snapshot, so changes need rsync and restart there.
`cloudflared tunnel info lighthouse-ada` can report an old inactive tunnel; a marked request traced in server logs is the reliable check of which machine serves.
workflow: Verify claims empirically (traced marker request, reading the actual server process env) instead of trusting status commands or scripts.
Use checksums to compare secrets between machines without printing values.
Do not rebuild the web app while a recorder is driving pages; the build would change the take halfway.
A recorder that only writes frames at the end loses everything if stopped early.
Commit locally without pushing when the user says not to push; report ahead-of-origin counts.
